findings.issue: Glossary freezes 'Feeding Grounds' (location) as مَرتَع exactly; this row adds الافتراس ('of predation'), a word not in the approved term.
Glossary reserves المُريد strictly for Tiel's Acolyte title and says generic 'disciples/followers' must use أتباع, never مريدون/مُريد. This is a generic disciple, not Tiel.
